final.investment_thesis:
The debate resolves to Hold because the two sides own different, non-overlapping evidence, and neither one wins decisively enough to justify moving a position that is already correctly small.

The bull's case is real, not residual: fiscal Q3 revenue +16.4% YoY to $109.42B, gross margin 50.05% (+356 bp), diluted EPS $2.02 (+28.7%), nine-month FCF $110.2B at 108.6% cash conversion, net cash $62.2B, and a long-term structure that is still intact — price +8.95% above a rising 200 SMA (279.87) with the 50 above the 200. That is why Sell/Underweight-to-zero is not supportable at range support, and why I reject the conservative analyst's implicit willingness to lean toward liquidation: the franchise is not impaired and the bear's own plan is to trim into 311-314 strength, not to sell at 304.91.

The bear's case is the more important tactical evidence and it is why I will not add a dollar: on 2026-07-31, the session the market received that quarter, AAPL gapped -8.58% and closed -7.35% on 132.5M shares — the heaviest volume and worst single-session decline in the visible window — then failed to reclaim anything, printing lower highs (313.33 → 308.26 → 304.91), sitting below the 10 EMA, 50 SMA, 20 SMA and VWMA, with MACD below zero and the histogram re-widening. The market saw the strong reported numbers and repriced the forward outlook lower anyway; that is information, and the Jefferies downgrade to Underperform with a -7.7% target plus memory-cost and design chatter are negative catalysts that are directionally credible even if the magnitude is low-confidence. Using the technical report's own 45% chop / 35% down / 20% up weights, near-term expected value from 304.91 is slightly negative — so converting cash into stock here is the worse trade.

Sizing — why 2.94% is the chosen total exposure. A higher allocation, 5-6% (the pre-08-07 weight), would buy directly into overhead supply (VWMA 318.14, 20 SMA 322.48) ahead of a mechanical 10/50 cross trigger with negative near-term expected value; that is paying up to be early, and it is rejected. A lower allocation, 0-1.5%, is also rejected on execution grounds: it realizes the current -$47.92 unrealized loss and pays ~10 bp in fees at the bottom of a shelf that has held three times on contracting volume, and the bear's own framework says trim into 311-314, not at 304.91. Repeated proportional trimming without a fresh total-target justification is precisely the failure mode the sizing rules warn about, and the 6%→3% cut two sessions ago already discharged the de-risking need. Cost basis ($309.89 including fees) is not the reason to hold — break-even is irrelevant to the decision — the reason is that the marginal sale at 304.91 is poor execution and the marginal purchase is poor entry.

Cash opportunity cost versus downside risk. Cash is ~97% of the account and earns no interest, so holding only 2.94% in AAPL forfeits most of any rally — that is a genuine cost. But it is bounded and symmetric at this size: a ±4-5% stock move changes total equity by only about ±0.13-0.14%. Downside to the 297.91 Bollinger lower band is about -2.3% on the stock, roughly -0.07% of total equity; upside on a 313.37 reclaim and gap-fill toward 318-322 is about +4-5%, roughly +0.13% of equity. Neither side of that ledger is large enough to force a directional bet, and with the technical weights tilted slightly negative, cash is not clearly the loser today.

The purpose of the retained position is not 'observation' — observing evidence requires no shares. It is a small, defined-loss claim on mean reversion and the 318-322 gap-fill in a highly cash-generative franchise, held at a cost of roughly ±0.13% of total account equity, which is cheaper than liquidating now and rebuilding after a 10 bp round trip once the tape confirms. That is a practical economic purpose consistent with its size.

What would change the call. Upgrade toward Overweight on a daily close above 318.14 (VWMA) with volume above 65M, or two consecutive closes above the 313.37 10 EMA that keep the 10/50 cross from printing. Downgrade toward Underweight on a weekly close below 297.91, which opens the low 290s, and toward Sell on a volume break of 300.00 that is not reclaimed. Fundamental tripwires at the late-October Q4 FY2026 print: gross margin (bullish at or above 49.5%, bearish at or below 47.5%), revenue trajectory, inventory at 2026-09-30 (bearish above $13B), and net cash (bearish below $45B).

Explicitly missing and not papered over: no valuation multiples (P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield), no Q4 consensus, no news coverage of the 2026-08-04 to 08-09 window, no insider data, and no options chain or implied volatility. Accordingly the price target offered is technical, not valuation-derived. Because the 07-31 open gapped 8.6% through the prior close, any resting stop is indicative only.
